title: AI-driven Supply Chain Analytics Platform
description_text: The Governmnet is seeking information from industry on AI-powered supply chain analytical tools. This RFI is issued solely for market research and planning purposes. By accessing these documents, interested parties acknowledge that they will: • Use the information solely for the purpose of responding to this RFI • Safeguard the information from unauthorized disclosure • Not distribute, release, reproduce, or disclose the information outside their organization without prior written approval from the Government • Ensure any internal personnel accessing the information understand these restrictions Submission of an RFI response constitutes acknowledgement of these restrictions and agreement to protect the information accordingly.
